When `padding: 32px` is added to `root>body>panel`'s CSS block but has no effect on the rendering, it indicates that the padding rule is being shadowed (overridden) by a conflicting CSS rule defined in an ancestor node's block. Since `root>body` is the immediate parent container whose styles cascade down and shadow the child element's padding, its CSS block must be edited to remove or resolve the conflicting rule.

ANSWER: root>body
